mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts indicates a broad-based economic contraction, which triggers a negative feedback loop in equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline for two consecutive months over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) above $350 billion signals overheating in the housing market, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods when RSAFS exceeds $350 billion during late-cycle expansions over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment above 150,000 jobs per month indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 jobs per month over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which triggers expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% year-over-year over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a combination of rising FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL above 2.0% signals aggressive policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0% during monetary tightening cycles over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 550,000 units signals a contraction in the residential sector, reducing economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods when HOUST falls below 550.0 over a 5-year rolling window.
